title: Web/UI Pictiq Stress Test 2026-09
status: HUMAN_SEMANTIC_RECONCILIATION_COMPLETE / LOCAL RESULTS FOR HUMAN REVIEW
method: Frozen 24-case Web/UI semantic corpus encoded with current Pictiq only; no vocabulary, grammar, schema, icon, renderer, Composer, or context-pack changes.
suggested_editorial_angle: What a Visual Language Learns When You Make It Describe Software

cases.source_intent: Back to previous screen or step
optional_information: whether browser history or workflow step
cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts existing backward/directional representation as sufficient in a back-control context.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Uses left/lesser relation as current best approximation; lacks explicit history/return.

cases.minimal_semantic_target: Move to next step or forward history
optional_information: submit vs carousel vs browser history
cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts existing forward/directional representation as sufficient in a next/forward UI context.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Right/greater works as directional cue but not as explicit workflow-next.

optional_information: physical home vs app start vs dashboard
cases.analysis_notes: In an app/UI context, place_home can naturally mean home/start/main location; no HOME_UI primitive needed.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Existing HOME is broad and context can recover app-start, but without UI context it reads as shelter/home.

cases.analysis_notes: Close/cancel can use NO or MINUS depending on interface context; no dedicated CLOSE/CANCEL primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: NO can express refusal/cancel only with strong UI context; close/dismiss is not explicit.

cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts YES for selected/active state where the UI supplies the selectable object.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: HERE + YES can mark current selected item but selection requires UI location.

cases.analysis_notes: Current/here remains a direct representation for active/current page.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: rel_here is a strong current-location marker in UI context.

cases.pressure_notes: disabled vs permission denied vs unavailable
cases.analysis_notes: NO can mark disabled/cannot-use in a control context; no DISABLED primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: NO marks non-availability but cannot distinguish disabled from denial, outage, missing input, or policy.

cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts TIME as contextual wait/loading/processing/in-progress representation; not a current GAP.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Current vocabulary lacks wait/loading/process/progress. time alone would be misleading.

optional_information: whether no results, no permission, or first use
cases.analysis_notes: Empty state should be expressed as absence of the relevant content, e.g. NO + TEXT or NO + IMAGE; no EMPTY primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Minus/less can suggest absence but does not clearly mean empty content.

cases.analysis_notes: Success/completed can use GOOD or YES + GOOD depending on context.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: YES + GOOD gives positive completion but needs context for operation scope.

cases.minimal_semantic_target: Something failed or is bad and needs attention
cases.analysis_notes: Error/failure can use BAD + !; warning/attention can use !.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Bad + urgent marks problem, but not machine error type.

optional_information: local save vs cloud sync vs autosave
cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts DOWN as contextual save/download/move-into-storage in UI context. SAVE is not canonically identical to DOWNLOAD.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: No current primitive for save/keep/record/storage; checkmark would overstate completion.

cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts UP as contextual publish/upload/send outward; communication can be added when speech/message semantics matter.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Text + speak/communication can imply communicative content but not the action of sending/publishing.

cases.analysis_notes: Delete/remove can be NO + relevant object or MINUS depending on context; no trash/delete primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: NO + DEAD can signal removal/destruction but is strong and context-dependent.

cases.minimal_semantic_target: Move item out of active view but retain it
cases.analysis_notes: Archive may use DOWN + relevant content/object to suggest moving/storing elsewhere, but the exact composition is unresolved. Dedicated ARCHIVE is DEFERRED_UNTIL_NEEDED.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Current vocabulary cannot preserve remove-from-view + keep distinction.

cases.analysis_notes: Domain pressure around EDIT revealed the broader Core primitive action_change: CHANGE / TRANSFORM / MODIFY. It is not merely an EDIT icon.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Text + tools suggests work on text but does not clearly mean edit.

cases.minimal_semantic_target: Reverse last action or restore prior state
cases.analysis_notes: Undo/restore can use backward/back directional meaning in editor history context; no UNDO/RESTORE primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Previous + time approximates past, not undo/restore.

cases.analysis_notes: Login/access can use PERSON + HERE or related current composition; no LOGIN primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Person + yes can mean user accepted/present; does not encode login/authentication.

cases.minimal_semantic_target: User cannot do action because permission is missing
cases.analysis_notes: Permission denied can use NO + PERSON or NO + HERE depending on UI context; no PERMISSION primitive from this test.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Person + no indicates denial but lacks role/policy/action scope.

optional_information: system vs account vs object settings
cases.analysis_notes: Human review accepts service_tools/TOOLS as sufficiently broad for settings/configuration/tools in software context; no gear/settings icon.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Tools is close to maintenance/repair, not abstract preferences/configuration.

cases.analysis_notes: Download uses DOWN + content in digital context; no conventional download glyph primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Down + text approximates download only because UI convention maps down to receive.

cases.analysis_notes: Upload uses UP + content in digital context; no conventional upload glyph primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Up + text approximates upload by convention, not explicit transfer.

cases.analysis_notes: Existing media_text is sufficient.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Direct hit.

cases.analysis_notes: Notification/message alert can use communication primitives plus ! depending on actual meaning; no MESSAGE/NOTIFICATION primitive.

initial_analysis.analysis_notes: Communication + urgent can signal notification but not unread/message object exactly.

summary.suggested_editorial_angle: What a Visual Language Learns When You Make It Describe Software

post_review_updates.rationale: Human semantic review found a broader CHANGE / TRANSFORM / MODIFY / BECOME DIFFERENT primitive rather than a Web/UI-specific EDIT icon.
post_review_updates.scope: Does not reconcile loading, save, archive, settings, IT/system, video, upload/download, notification, or permission/access.

reconciliation.principle: Attempt actual products/interfaces with current Pictiq, observe direct need, then reconsider vocabulary.
